nidassana: Nidassana (nt.) [Sk. nidarśana, ni+dassana] "손가락질 하는" 증거, 예, 비교, 동격, 속성, 특징; 표식, 개념 D I.223 (a° 특징이 없는); III.217 (id.); S IV.370 (id.); A IV.305 sq. (nīla°, pīta° etc.); Sn 137; Vbh 13, 64, 70 sq. (sa°, a°); VvA 12, 13; PvA 26, 121 (pucchanākāra°) 226 (paccakkhabhūtaṁ n. "표식, 증표").
nidassati: Nidassati v. l. BB at Sn 785 for nirassati (q. v.) Nd1 76 has nid° in text, nir° as v. l. SS; SnA 522 reads nirassati.
nidassita: Nidassita (pp.) [see nidasseti] 지적한, ~으로 정의한, 개념지은 Pv I.512; PvA 30.
nidasseti: Nidasseti [Sk. nidarśayati, ni+dasseti] 지적하다 ("아래"), 설명하다, 보여주다, 정의하다 VvA 12, 13 (°etabbavacana 비교 또는 정의해야할 단어, correl. to nidassana--vacana). -- pp. nidassita (q. v.).
nidahati: Nidahati [Sk. nidadhāti, ni+dahati1] 눕히다 또는 치우다, 맡기다; 적재하다, 쌓다, (보물을) 묻어두다 Vin I.46 (cīvaraṁ); Miln 271; ger. nidahitvā PvA 97 (dhanadhaññaṁ) & nidhāya Dh 142, 405; Sn 35 (daṇḍaṁ), 394, 629; Nd2 348; pres. also nidheti KhA 217, 219; fut. nidhessati PvA 132. Pass. nidhīyati KhA 217. Caus. nidhāpeti PvA 130 (bhoge). See also nidāhaka, nidhāna & nidhi; also upanidhāya.
nidāgha: Nidāgha [Sk. nidāgha, fr. nidahati, ni+dahati2, see Dahati] 열기, 여름의 열기, 여름, 가뭄 J I.221 (--samaya dry season); II.80; Vism 259 (°samaya, where KhA 58 reads sarada--samaya); PvA 174 (--kāla 여름). fig. J IV.285; V.404; Dāvs II.60.
nidāna: Nidāna (nt.) [Sk. nidāna, ni+*dāna of dā, dyati to bind, cp. Gr. de/sma, dh_ma (fetter) & see dāma] (a) (n.) ~에 매인; 토양 (문자적 또는 비유적으로), 토대, 경우; 근원, 근본, 원인; 이유, 언급, 주제 ("sujet") M I.261; A I.134 sq.; 263 sq., 338; II.196; IV.128 sq.; Dhs 1059 (dukkha°, 고통의 근원), 1136; Nett 3, 32; Miln 272 (병의: 병리학, 병인학), 344 (°paṭhanakusala, 법관의); PvA 132, 253. <-> (b) (adj.--°) ~에 토대를 둔, ~에 근거한, ~에서 비롯한, ~에 관계된 S V.213 sq. (a° & sa°); A I.82 (id.); Sn 271 (ito°), 866 (kuto°), 1050 (upadhi°=hetuka, paccayā, kāraṇā Nd2 346); 872 (icchā°) etc.; VvA 117 (vimānāni Rājagaha° 라자가하에서 노는 또는 라자가하에 관한). -- (c) nidānaṁ (acc. as adv.) ~에 의한, ~을 결과로 한, ~을 통해서, 통상 tato° 와 함께, 이것을 통해, yato° ~을 통해 D I.52, 73; M I.112; Pv IV.161 (~를 통해=yaṁ nimittaṁ PvA 242); PvA 281; ito° 이것으로 Nd2 2912.
nidāhaka: Nidāhaka (adj.) [fr. nidahati] 치우는 사람, 지키는 또는 막는 사람 (of robes: cīvara°) Vin I.284.
nidda: Nidda (nt.) [nis+dara, see darī] 동굴 Nd1 23 (Ep. of kāya).
niddanta: Niddanta [so read for niddanna, v. l. niddhā=niddā; cp. supinanta]=niddā J VI.294.
niddaya: Niddaya (adj.) [Sk. nirdaya, nis+dayā (adj.)] 자비심 없는, 무자비한, 잔인한 Sdhp 143, 159.
niddara: Niddara (adj.) [nis+dara] 두려움 없는, 고통 또는 괴로움 Dh 205=Sn 257 (expld at DhA III.269 by rāgadarathānaṁ abhāvena n.; at SnA 299 by kilesapariḷāhâbhāvena n.).
niddā: Niddā (f.) [Vedic nidrā, ni+drā in Sk. drāti, drāyate, Idg. *dorē; cp. Gr. (hom.) e)/draqon, Lat. dormio] 잠 A II.48, 50; III.251; Sn 926 (opp. jāgariyā), 942 (see expln at Nd1 423); J I.61, 192; II.128. -- niddaṁ okkamati 잠이 들다 Vin I.15 (niddā?); J III.538; IV.1; DhA I.9; VvA 65; PvA 47; °ṁ upagacchati id. PvA 43, 105, 128. --ārāma 잠을 좋아하는, 나태한, 게으른 It 72 (+kammarāma, bhassarata); --ārāmatā 잠을 좋아함, 게으름, 나태함 A III.116, 293 sq., 309 sq.; IV.25 (+kamm°, bhass°); V.164; --sīlin 조는 습관, 나태한, 졸린 Sn 96.
niddāna: Niddāna (nt.) [Sk. *nirdāna, nis+dāna of dayati2, Sk. dāti, cp. dātta] 잘라낸, 뽑은, 파괴한 Sn 78 (=chedana lunana uppāṭana SnA 148)=S I.172; K.S. I.319, cp. niDDāyati.
niddāyati: Niddāyati [Denom. fr. niddā] 잠자다 D I.231; J I.192, 266; II.103; V.68, 382; DhA III.175; SnA 169.
niddāyitar: Niddāyitar [n. ag. fr. niddāyati] 졸음을 느끼는 사람 Dh 325.
niddiṭṭha: Niddiṭṭha (pp.) [see niddisati] 표현한, 설명한, 지정된 Miln 3; DhsA 57; Vism 528; VvA 13.
niddisati: Niddisati ( & niddissati) [Sk. nir--diśati, nis+disati, cp. Lat. distinguo] 구별하다, 가리키다, 설명하다, 지적하다, 정의하다, 표현하다, 뜻하다 It 122=Nd2 276f; Miln 123, 345; DhsA 57; DhA II.59; PvA 87, 217 (°itvā); aor. niddisi DhsA 57; SnA 61. -- grd. niddisitabba DhsA 56; Nett 96. Pass. niddissīyati PvA 163. -- pp. niddiṭṭha (q. v.).
niddissati: Niddisati ( & niddissati) [Sk. nir--diśati, nis+disati, cp. Lat. distinguo] 구별하다, 가리키다, 설명하다, 지적하다, 정의하다, 표현하다, 뜻하다 It 122=Nd2 276f; Miln 123, 345; DhsA 57; DhA II.59; PvA 87, 217 (°itvā); aor. niddisi DhsA 57; SnA 61. -- grd. niddisitabba DhsA 56; Nett 96. Pass. niddissīyati PvA 163. -- pp. niddiṭṭha (q. v.).
niddukkha: Niddukkha (adj.) [nis+dukkha] 실수 또는 잘못됨 없이 J III.443 (in expln of anīgha); PvA 230 (id.); (in expln of mārisa) K.S. (S.A.) 1, 2, n. 1.
niddesa:
Niddesa [Sk. nirdeśa, fr. niddisati, cp. desa, desaka etc.] 1. 묘사, 속성, 뚜렷함 PvA 7 (ukkaṭṭha°); °vatthu 구별 대상 또는 칭찬의 대상 D III.253= A IV.15 (where reading is niddasa, which also as v. l. at D III.253 & Ps I.5). -- 2. 묘사적 주해, 질문과 대답에 의한 분석적 설명, 해석, 주해 Vin V.114 (sa°); Nett 4, 8 38 sq.; Vism 26; DhsA 54; VvA 78; PvA 71, 147. <-> 3. (Sāriputta 가 지은 것으로 보이는) Sutta 의 일부인 오래된 주석서의 이름
Nipāta (Aṭṭhaka--vagga, Mahā--Niddesa 에 해석되어 있는; Pārāyana--vagga and, 부록의 일종, the Khaggavisāṇa--sutta, Culla--Niddesa에 해석되어 있는); Khuddaka Nikāya에 포함된 본경들 중의 하나; editions in P.T.S. Quoted often in the Visuddhimagga, e. g. p. 140, 208 sq. etc.
niddosa: Niddosa1 (adj.) [Sk. nirdośa, nis+dosa1] 잘못 없는, 순수한, 더럽혀지지 않은 Sn 476; DhsA 2; PvA 189 (=viraja); DhA I.41.
Niddosa2 (adj.) [Sk. nirdveṣa, nis+dosa2] 미움 없는 J IV.10 (su°; Com. "adussanavasena," foll. upon sunikkodha).
niddhana: Niddhana (adj.) [nis+dhana] 재산 없는, 가난한 J V.447.
niddhanta: Niddhanta (adj.) [pp. of niddhamati, nis+dhanta, q. v.] 불어날린, 제거한, 깨끗이 치운, 정화된 A I.254 (jātarūpa "배회하는" cp. niddhota); Sn 56 (°kasāva--moha; Com. vijahati); Dh 236 (°mala, malānaṁ nīhaṭatāya DhA III.336); Nd2 347 (=vanta & pahīna); J VI.218 (of hair; Com. expls siniddharutā, v. l. BB siniddha--anta, thus meant for Sk. snigdhānta).
niddhamati: Niddhamati [in form=Sk. nirdhmāti, nis+dhamati, but in meaning the verb, as well as its derivations, are influenced by both meanings of niddhāvati (dhāvati1 & 2): see niddhāpeti, niddhamana, & niddhovati] 불어날리다, 청산하다; 깨끗이 하다, 깨끗이 치우다, 정화하다; 던져버리다, 내뿜다, 제거하다 Sn 281=Miln 414 (kāraṇḍavaṁ); Sn 282 (°itvā pāpicche), 962 (malaṁ=pajahati (Nd1 478); Dh 239 (id.); Miln 43. -- pp. niddhanta).
niddhamana: Niddhamana (nt.) [of niddhamati or=*nirdhāvana= °dhovana to dhāvati2] 배수, 배수관, 수로 Vin II.120 (udaka°; dhovituṁ immediately preceding); J I.175, 409, 425; III.415; IV.28; V.21 (udaka°); DhA II.37.
niddhamanā: Niddhamanā (f.) [either to niddhamati or to niddhāpeti] 내던짐, 분출, 방출 J V.233 (=nikkaddhanā Com.).
niddharaṇa: Niddharaṇa (nt.) Hardy (Index VvA)=Sk. nirdhāraṇa (평가) 처럼이 아닌, nittharaṇa 로 읽어야 함(see nittharaṇa2).
niddhāpita: Niddhāpita (adj.) [pp. of niddhāpeti, q. v.] 내던진J III.99 (v. l. for nibbāpita).
niddhāpeti: Niddhāpeti [Sk. nirdhāvayati, nis+dhāveti (dhāpeti), Caus. of dhāvati1; may also stand for niddhamāpeti, Caus. fr. niddhamati, cp. contamination niddhāmase at J IV.48, unless misread for niddhāpaye, as v. l. BB bears out] 던지다, 버리다, 쫓아내다 J IV.41 (niddhāpayiṁsu), 48 (? for niddhāmase). pp. niddhāpita.
niddhāmase: Niddhāmase J IV.48는 niddhāpaye 로 읽어야 할지도 (as v. l. BB), q. v.
niddhunāti: Niddhunāti [Sk. nirdhunoti, nis+dhunāti] 흔들어대다 S III.155; A III.365 (odhunāti+; spelt nidhunāti); M I.229; Th 1, 416; PvA 256 (=odhunāti).
niddhuniya: Niddhuniya (?) (nt.) [=Sk. nihnuvana fr. nihnute with diff. derivation] 위선 Pug 18 (=makkha); cp. J.P.T.S. 1884, 83.
niddhota: Niddhota (adj.) [nis+dhota; pp. of niddhovati] 씻은, 깨끗이 한, 정화한 Dāvs V.63 (°rūpiya; cp. niddhanta).
niddhovati: Niddhovati [Sk. nirdhāvati, nis+dhovati, cp. niddhamati] 씻어내다, 깨끗이 하다, 정화하다 A I.253 (jātarūpaṁ, immediately followed by niddhanta). pp. niddhota.
nidhāna: Nidhāna (nt.) [Vedic nidhāna, see nidahati] 눕다, 맡기다, 보관하다; 그릇; 적재, (숨은) 보물 J IV.280 (nidhi°); PvA 7 (udaka--dāna--nīharaṇa--n°), 97 (n--gata dhana=쌓은, 적재한), 132 (°ṁ nidhessāmi 보물을 모으는); DhsA 405 (°kkhama).
nidhānavant: Nidhānavant (adj.) 그릇 모양을 한 또는 그릇을 갖고 있는, 보물의 가치가 있는 또는 모을 가치가 있는 D I.4 (=hadaye nidhātabba--yuttavāca DA I.76).
nidhi: Nidhi [Vedic nidhi, ni+dhā, see nidahati] 1. "내려 놓는," 그릇; (숨은) 보물 Sn 285 (brahma n.); Dh 76; Kh VIII.2 (see KhA 217 sq.: nidhīyatī ti nidhi, def. of n.), 9 (acorâharaṇo nidhi cp. "도둑들이 훔치지 않는 천상에 있는 보물" Matt. 6, 20); Sdhp 528, 588. -- 2. "입는," 망토 J VI.79 (expld as vākacīra--nivāsanaṁ=나무껍질 옷). Cp. sannidhi. --kumbhī 보물 항아리, 항아리에 감추어둔 보물=숨은 보물 DhA II.107; IV.208; --nidhāna laying up treasures, burying a treasure J IV.280; --mukha 빼어난 보물 A V.346.
